evidence.observed: Initial prompt did not require exact subtotal/discount/shipping arithmetic; telemetry logs has_parseable_total and tool traces for verification.

findings.root_cause: The shipped prompt encouraged a free-form total and temperature was 1.6, making the LLM estimate instead of computing deterministically.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite prompt with the exact floor discount formula; set temperature low; enable verify and self_consistency.

evidence.observed: Initial prompt allowed a total even when stock/product/destination data was missing; wrapper now logs parseable totals and status.

findings.root_cause: The agent was not instructed to ground answers only in check_stock/get_discount/calc_shipping outputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Prompt requires tool-first grounding and refusal with no total when product is unknown, out of stock, invalid, or unserviceable.

evidence.observed: Wrapper records tools, tool_count, repeated_tool, steps, and trace for every request.

findings.root_cause: No tool budget and no instruction limiting calls allowed redundant tool use and loops.
findings.suggested_fix: Set tool_budget to 4, max_steps to 7, enable loop_guard, and instruct each tool at most once per field.

evidence.observed: Wrapper scans and redacts answer text before returning/logging; logs include pii_redactions.

findings.root_cause: Initial config had redact_pii false and prompt did not forbid repeating customer contact details.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable redact_pii, use telemetry.redact in wrapper, and add a no-PII prompt rule.

evidence.observed: Wrapper marks sanitized=true when order notes or fake system/developer/tool instructions appear.

findings.root_cause: Customer notes were treated as instructions, so hidden fake prices or role text could override tool facts.
findings.suggested_fix: Prompt treats notes as untrusted data; wrapper neutralizes suspicious note lines and reminds the model to use tools only.

evidence.observed: Initial config disabled unicode normalization and included a catalog_override marking macbook out of stock.

findings.root_cause: Misconfigured normalization and catalog override can make valid products/cities fail.

evidence.observed: Wrapper logs status, error, error_message, tools, and trace-derived metadata for each request; initial config also set a high tool_error_rate.

findings.root_cause: Intermittent tool/API failures were not retried in the shipped config.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable retry with bounded attempts and backoff; wrapper catches call_next exceptions and retries once.

evidence.observed: Wrapper logs wall_ms and meta.latency_ms; long requests correlate with extra planning/self-consistency and redundant tool calls.

findings.root_cause: Planner, large context, verbose system text, and repeated tool calls increase tail latency.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a concise prompt, smaller context, loop guard, low tool_budget, cache, and avoid unnecessary self-consistency.

evidence.observed: Wrapper records usage and cost_usd; self-consistency/planner multiply prompt tokens.

findings.root_cause: Verbose prompts, extra planning, and duplicate samples burn tokens without adding task value.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a short prompt, disable planner, reduce self_consistency when stable, cap output, and cache repeated requests.

evidence.observed: Wrapper logs session_id and turn_index so answers can be grouped by later turns; config had nonzero session_drift_rate.

findings.root_cause: Long sessions allow accumulated context/noise to degrade order extraction and arithmetic.
findings.suggested_fix: Reset context periodically and keep context_size small.

evidence.observed: Wrapper logs steps, tool_count, repeated_tool, and non-ok status to catch loops/max-step behavior.

findings.root_cause: The shipped config disabled loop_guard and had no useful tool budget.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable loop_guard, reduce max_steps, and cap tool_budget.
